Implementation details and any further terminal handling can remain unknown, but stopping retries after the defined terminal failure must remain established. Merely repeating the original task above this contradictory context does not resolve the weakening.

limitations: This is a fresh-context model review from the same operator, not independent human evidence or execution verification.

Only the 14 opaque item directories' originals and submissions in the requested frozen directory were inspected. No mappings or other project results were read; the previous report was left unchanged.
For submissions with a handoff block, findings concern the actual copyable block. Outside-block declarations, excuses, and self-review claims do not cure an inside-block defect.

The same materiality threshold as the previous blind review was used: harmless formatting, faithful decomposition, ordinary requested-outcome evidence, and visibly optional suggestions were not counted as drift. Missing-input questions and blocked handoffs were accepted where the input was genuinely absent.

The general preparation directive in item-09 was read within its explicit confirmed authority list; it was not treated as a separate grant of unlisted remote or consequential operations. The item-10 authority text remains a placeholder to populate from the missing task contract.
Readiness describes usability of the prompt as written, including legitimate input holds. It does not establish implementation, test, CI, MR, merge, or deployment success.
